violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW SHELL EGGS STORED ABOVE MILK IN AVANTCO 2 DOOR PREP TOP (HAND SINK).
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: MILK AT 47F, CHEESE AT 46F AND FRANKS AT 45F IN AVANTCO 2 DOOR PREP TOP (DOOR).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO TRANSFER FOODS TO OTHER REFRIGERATION UNIT FOR RAPID COOLING TO 41F.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items: CLEANING CHEMICALS STORED ON SHELVING AND UNDER COUNTER WITH FOODS AND UTENSILS.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC RELOCATED CHEMICALS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equip/Utensils, Durable under Normal Use
violations.observation: The following equipment is not designed and constructed to be durable: INSTANT FOOD COOKER USED FOR SELF SERVICE COOKING OF NOODLES WITHOUT NSF OR OTHER APPROVED CERTIFICATIONS VISIBLE.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment and utensils shall be designed and constructed to be durable and to retain their characteristic qualities under normal use conditions. EDUCATION PROVIDED. MANAGEMENT INDICATED CERTIFICATION INFORMATION WILL BE REQUESTED AND FORWARDED TO EHS.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: AVANTCO 2 DOOR PREP TOP (DOOR) AT 43- 48F
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO TRANSFER TCS FOODS PURCHASED EARLIER TO OTHER REFRIGERATION UNIT. DO NOT STORE TCS FOODS IN UNIT UNTIL REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN FOOD TEMPERATURES AT 41F OR BELOW. PLEASE EMAIL EHS ONCE UNIT HAS BEEN REPAIRED.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: REFRIGERATION UNITS, COUNTER TOPS, FOOD STORAGE CONTAINERS.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE CLEAN AND IMPLEMENT AN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE.
